sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: MODELS ARE IN FAIRLY GOOD AGREEMENT SHOWING THE SRN EXTENT OF THE WRN U.S. TROUGH BECOMING CUT-OFF FROM THE NRN STREAM BY THE START OF DAY 1. THE CLOSED LOW WILL MOVE SLOWLY EWD TODAY ACROSS NM...GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF A RATHER STRONG DOWNSTREAM RIDGE EXTENDING NWD FROM THE LOWER MS VALLEY/CENTRAL GULF COAST STATES TO THE WRN GREAT LAKES. MEANWHILE...HEIGHTS WILL RISE ACROSS THE SERN STATES AS A TROUGH LOCATED ALONG THE MIDDLE/NRN ATLANTIC COAST MOVES EWD. A WEAK MIDLEVEL CIRCULATION...CURRENTLY MOVING SLOWLY NWD INLAND FROM THE MID-UPPER TX COAST...SHOULD TRACK NEWD TODAY THROUGH E TX/ARKLATEX AND LOWER MS VALLEY REACHING THE OZARKS AND NRN MS BY 12Z TUESDAY. THE NRN EXTENT OF THE WRN TROUGH...CURRENTLY MOVING EWD THROUGH THE NRN INTERMOUNTAIN WEST PER WATER VAPOR IMAGERY...IS EXPECTED TO TRACK ENEWD THROUGH THE NRN HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON AS IT PHASES WITH A SEPARATE TROUGH MOVING THROUGH CENTRAL CANADA. MODELS DIFFER WITH THE EFFECT THE SRN PORTION OF THESE PHASED TROUGHS HAS ACROSS NRN MN...BUT THE 12Z ECMWF/00Z GFS AGREE THAT 40-60 METER HEIGHT FALLS SHOULD OCCUR ACROSS THAT REGION MONDAY NIGHT. AT THE SURFACE...A COLD FRONT WILL ADVANCE E/SEWD INTO THE UPPER MS VALLEY THIS

sections.title: CENTRAL TX/WRN AND CENTRAL OK/CENTRAL AND ERN KS
sections.text: A SHORTWAVE TROUGH...CURRENTLY MOVING INTO THE BASE OF THE WRN TROUGH OVER SWRN AZ PER WATER VAPOR IMAGERY...IS EXPECTED TO MIGRATE THROUGH THE SERN-ERN PERIPHERY OF THE PARENT CLOSED LOW TODAY ACROSS SW-W TX INTO WRN OK AND POSSIBLY SWRN KS BY 03/00Z. WEAK HEIGHT FALLS ACROSS THE SRN PLAINS...DPVA ATTENDANT TO THE MIGRATORY SHORTWAVE TROUGH...AND DIFFLUENT MID-UPPER LEVEL FLOW ALL EXPECTED ACROSS THE DRY LINE DURING THE MID-LATE AFTERNOON SUGGEST TSTM DEVELOPMENT WILL BE LIKELY FROM CENTRAL/SOUTH CENTRAL TX NWD THROUGH WRN OK TO SOUTH CENTRAL KS. THE STRONGEST LOW LEVEL CONVERGENCE SHOULD EXTEND FROM NWRN OK/ADJACENT KS NEAR THE TRIPLE POINT NEWD ALONG THE COLD FRONT/DRY LINE MERGER INTO CENTRAL KS...WITH MUCH OF THE KS TSTM ACTIVITY EXPECTED TO BE MORE ANAFRONTAL-TYPE DEVELOPMENT. SURFACE HEATING WITHIN THE WARM SECTOR COMBINED WITH VERY STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES /EXCEEDING 8 C PER KM/...AND SURFACE DEWPOINTS IN THE 60S WILL RESULT IN MODERATE TO VERY STRONG INSTABILITY WITHIN THE TX/OK/KS PORTION OF THE SLIGHT RISK AREA. EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR WILL BE STRONGEST ACROSS S TO N CENTRAL TX WITH SHEAR VECTORS ORIENTED PERPENDICULAR TO THE DRY LINE. THIS WILL PROVE FAVORABLE FOR DISCRE

sections.title: E TX/MUCH OF LA/SRN AR
sections.text: THE AIR MASS IS EXPECTED TO BECOME MODERATELY UNSTABLE ACROSS MUCH OF THIS REGION INTO THE AFTERNOON. FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO THE NEWD MOVING MIDLEVEL CIRCULATION WILL SUPPORT WIDESPREAD TSTM DEVELOPMENT. EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR AROUND 30 KT SUGGESTS MULTICELLS WILL BE THE PRIMARY STORM MODE WITH AN ATTENDANT THREAT FOR HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS.

sections.title: UPPER MS VALLEY/WRN GREAT LAKES TO NRN IL/IND
sections.text: A FEW STRONG TO ISOLATED SEVERE ELEVATED STORMS ARE POSSIBLE AT THE START OF DAY 1 FROM ERN SD INTO NRN MN WITHIN A STRONG LOW LEVEL WAA REGIME. WEAK-MODERATE ELEVATED INSTABILITY AND 25-30 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR SUPPORT THIS MARGINAL SEVERE HAIL THREAT. ELEVATED CONVECTION/EMBEDDED TSTMS ARE POSSIBLE FROM NERN SD INTO NRN MN THROUGH THE DAY...BUT WEAKER INSTABILITY WILL PRECLUDE A SEVERE WEATHER THREAT. A GREATER COVERAGE OF TSTMS...AGAIN MAINLY ELEVATED...IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP BY EARLY EVENING ACROSS PARTS OF SRN MN/POTENTIALLY NRN IA...NEAR AND N OF A SURFACE LOW MOVING INTO NWRN IA FROM NEB TODAY. IF SURFACE BASED STORMS CAN DEVELOP NEAR THE LOW IN IA...THEN THE SLIGHT RISK AREA MAY NEED TO BE EXTENDED NWD...AS MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY WOULD SUPPORT A GREATER SEVERE WEATHER THREAT. OTHERWISE...A STRENGTHENING/VEERING LLJ FROM THE UPPER MS VALLEY INTO THE WRN GREAT LAKES IS EXPECTED TO SUPPORT ELEVATED TSTMS DEVELOPING AND SPREADING ESEWD ACROSS THESE AREAS. ALTHOUGH EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR IS FORECAST TO WEAKEN OVER THE WRN GREAT LAKES TO NRN IL/IND MONDAY NIGHT...STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AND MODERATE ELEVATED INSTABILITY WILL SUPPORT PRIMARILY ISOLATED HAIL WITH THE

sections.title: SRN APPALACHIANS/SC/ERN GA
sections.text: THE AIR MASS IS EXPECTED TO BECOME MODERATELY UNSTABLE BY AFTERNOON WITH TSTMS DEVELOPING ALONG AND S OF THE COLD FRONT MOVING THROUGH THIS REGION. WEAK DEEP LAYER SHEAR WILL RESULT IN GENERALLY PULSE-TYPE STORMS WITH AN ATTENDANT THREAT FOR ISOLATED STRONG WIND GUSTS AND/OR SOME HAIL. ..PETERS/ROGERS.. 04/02/2012

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A COMPLEX UPR PATTERN WILL PREVAIL THIS PERIOD...WITH SVR TSTM POTENTIAL LARGELY TIED TO UPR SYSTEM NOW CLOSING OFF NEAR THE FOUR CORNERS. THE LOW SHOULD ELONGATE W-E AS IT DRIFTS ESE ACROSS NM LATER TODAY/TNGT. ONE OF THE RESULTING VORT LOBES ALREADY IS BECOMING APPARENT IN SATELLITE IMAGERY ATTM OVER SRN NM. THIS FEATURE SHOULD PIVOT NNE ACROSS W TX LATER TODAY...AND NWD ACROSS THE TX PANHANDLE TNGT...AS UPSTREAM LOBE MOVES S ACROSS AZ. SE OF THE FOUR CORNERS LOW...VWP AND SATELLITE DATA INDICATE THAT A FAIRLY BROAD MCV HAS EVOLVED OVER S CNTRL/SE TX FROM CONVECTIVE COMPLEX THAT CROSSED THE REGION OVERNIGHT. ALSO LINGERING IN THE AREA IS REMNANT OF THE SMALL UPR LVL CIRCULATION THAT FORMED OVER THE TX GULF CST YESTERDAY. THE COMBINED CIRCULATIONS SHOULD MOVE GENERALLY NNE ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF E TX AND LA/AR LATER TODAY/TNGT AS THEY BECOME ABSORBED WITHIN STRENGTHENING MID/UPR LVL FLOW DOWNSTREAM FROM THE FOUR CORNERS LOW. FARTHER N...NRN PART OF TROUGH THAT GAVE BIRTH TO THE FOUR CORNERS SYSTEM WILL TRACK E ACROSS MT AND THE DAKOTAS AS A HIGH AMPLITUDE RIDGE PERSISTS FROM THE ERN GULF CST TO THE UPR GRT LKS. EWD MOTION OF THE MT/DAKOTAS IMPULSE WILL MAINTAIN STEADY EWD ADVANCE

sections.title: W TX NNE INTO WRN/CNTRL KS AND SE NEB THIS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: CONDITIONS SHOULD BECOME INCREASINGLY FAVORABLE FOR STRONG TO SVR STORMS ALONG AN ARC FROM W CNTRL TX NWD THROUGH WRN OK...SW KS...N CNTRL KS...AND SE NEB LATER TODAY AS SFC HEATING DESTABILIZES REGION ALONG AND AHEAD OF MERGING DRY LINE AND PACIFIC COLD FRONT. EVOLUTION OF STORMS AND THEIR ATTENDANT SVR THREATS WILL BE COMPLICATED BY THE VARIABLE WIND FIELDS THAT WILL EXIST ACROSS THIS REGION THROUGH SPACE AND TIME AS NM VORT LOBE PIVOTS NE ACROSS REGION. ATTM IT APPEARS THAT THE MOST FAVORABLE JUXTAPOSITION OF DEEPLY VEERING WIND PROFILES...STEEP LOW TO MID LVL LAPSE RATES...AND LOW LVL MOISTURE WILL EXIST FROM WRN N TX N AND NNW THROUGH WRN OK INTO SW KS LATE THIS AFTN. EARLY PASSAGE OF THE VORT LOBE IN TX ADDS A FURTHER COMPLICATION TO THE SITUATION. BUT OVERALL COMBINATION OF PERSISTENT LOW LVL CONVERGENCE ALONG DRY LINE/COLD FRONT...STRONG INSTABILITY /SBCAPE 2500-3500 J PER KG/...AND WIND PROFILES THAT WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR SUSTAINED STORMS/SUPERCELLS EXPECTED TO YIELD A SIGNIFICANT SVR THREAT NONETHELESS. LARGE HAIL SHOULD BE THE DOMINANT SVR RISK...ALTHOUGH SOME POTENTIAL ALSO WILL EXIST FOR TORNADOES...ESPECIALLY IN SW KS AND WRN OK WHERE LOW LVL WINDS ARE APT TO REMAIN

sections.title: E TX INTO MUCH OF LA/AR LATER TODAY THROUGH THIS EVE
sections.text: SFC HEATING OF MOIST ENVIRONMENT DOWNSTREAM FROM S TX MCV WILL LEAD TO MODERATE INSTABILITY ACROSS MUCH OF E TX...LA...AND AR LATER TODAY...WITH SBCAPE LIKELY TO BE ON THE ORDER OF 2000 /KG. FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO THE N TO NE-MOVING CIRCULATION SHOULD FOSTER FAIRLY WIDESPREAD TSTM DEVELOPMENT. WHILE DEEP SHEAR WILL REMAIN COMPARATIVELY MODEST /AROUND 30 KTS/...SETUP COULD YIELD SCTD STRONG TO SVR WIND GUSTS AND HAIL. GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF FAVORABLE STORM INTERACTIONS AND/OR SMALL SCALE CIRCULATIONS WITHIN EXPECTED STORM CLUSTERS/BANDS...A CONDITIONAL RISK ALSO WILL EXIST FOR WEAK TORNADOES.

sections.title: ERN KY/TN INTO WRN NC/SC/ERN GA THIS AFTN
sections.text: FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH UPR TROUGH THAT AMPLIFIED OVER THE NERN U.S. LATE YESTERDAY SHOULD ADVANCE S ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF THE CAROLINAS TODAY...WHILE WRN PORTION BECOMES STNRY OVER THE LWR OH VLY. WEAK TO MODERATE DIURNAL INSTABILITY SHOULD DEVELOP ALONG AND S OF THE BOUNDARY...WITH SCTD TSTMS EXPECTED FROM ERN KY SSE INTO SC. MODERATE NWLY CLOUD LAYER SHEAR SHOULD YIELD MAINLY PULSE STORMS...A FEW OF WHICH COULD PRODUCE MARGINALLY SVR HAIL/ISOLD DMGG GUSTS.

sections.title: MN/IA INTO WI/IL/IND THROUGH PERIOD
sections.text: MOST OF THE UPR MS VLY/UPR MIDWEST WILL REMAIN BENEATH UPR RIDGE THROUGH THE PERIOD. PERIODIC EPISODES OF ENHANCED WAA/MOISTURE TRANSPORT MAY SUPPORT A FEW ROUNDS OF ELEVATED STORMS... ESPECIALLY LATE TNGT/EARLY TUE AS NRN STREAM SHORTWAVE TROUGH APPROACHES REGION. WHILE SOME OF THIS ACTIVITY MAY PRODUCE HAIL...MODEST ELEVATED INSTABILITY AND SHEAR SHOULD MITIGATE ANY THREAT FOR SUSTAINED SVR WEATHER. ..CORFIDI/COHEN.. 04/02/2012

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: MID AND UPPER-LEVEL LOW OVER THE SRN ROCKIES WILL EDGE SLOWLY EWD DURING THE D1 PERIOD WITH A STRONG VORTICITY MAXIMUM PIVOTING NNEWD THROUGH ERN PERIPHERY OF SYSTEM ACROSS WRN TX TODAY...AND ANOTHER IMPULSE EJECTING EWD ACROSS FAR WRN TX LATE TONIGHT. THIS EVOLUTION WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE NEWD PROGRESSION OF A COUPLE VORTICITY MAXIMA --ONE OF CONVECTIVE ORIGIN-- FROM SERN TX INTO THE LOWER MS VALLEY. ELSEWHERE...NRN BRANCH OF FULL-LATITUDE TROUGH CURRENTLY OVER THE ROCKIES WILL FRACTURE WITH THIS FEATURE MOVING ACROSS THE CANADIAN PRAIRIE PROVINCES AND NRN PLAINS THIS PERIOD. IN THE LOW LEVELS...SURFACE CYCLONE ATTENDANT TO PROGRESSIVE NRN PORTION OF UPPER TROUGH WILL MOVE SLOWLY ALONG THE MN/IA BORDER WHILE TRAILING COLD FRONT SETTLES SWD THROUGH THE CNTRL PLAINS. THIS FRONT WILL LINK WITH AN AREA OF LOW PRESSURE OVER THE TX PNHDL...AND A DRYLINE/PACIFIC FRONT WHICH WILL STRENGTHEN TODAY OVER THE ERN TX PNHDL/WRN OK SWD INTO W-CNTRL TX.

sections.title: SRN MN/IA INTO SRN PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: MORNING VISIBLE SATELLITE INDICATES THAT STRONG BOUNDARY LAYER HEATING WILL OCCUR TODAY ACROSS WARM SECTOR...WHICH WHEN COUPLED WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 50-LOW 60S AND STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES...WILL YIELD MLCAPE OF 2000-3500 J/KG. INITIAL TSTM DEVELOPMENT IS ANTICIPATED BY MID/LATE AFTERNOON ALONG PROGRESSIVE SEGMENT OF FRONT ACROSS NEB/KS...WITH INITIATION POSSIBLY DELAYED UNTIL EVENING INTO TONIGHT FARTHER S ALONG DRYLINE. 12Z MODEL GUIDANCE CONTINUES TO INDICATE THAT THE MOST FAVORABLE ENVIRONMENT FOR SUPERCELLS WILL RESIDE FROM NEAR FRONT-DRYLINE INTERSECTION OVER SWRN KS SWD ALONG DRYLINE INTO NWRN TX. HERE...VERTICALLY VEERING WIND PROFILES WITH 35-45 KT DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WILL ALIGN WITH THE MODERATE-STRONG INSTABILITY. LARGE HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY HAZARD...THOUGH THE RISK FOR TORNADOES WILL INCREASE THIS EVENING AS A STRENGTHENING LLJ ENHANCES LOW-LEVEL SHEAR. ADDITIONAL STORMS MAY DEVELOP THIS EVENING INVOF THE SURFACE LOW MOVING ALONG THE MN/IA BORDER WHERE LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE IS ENHANCED BY AN INTENSIFYING LLJ. WHILE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WILL REMAIN RATHER WEAK...THE PRESENCE OF STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AND MODERATE INSTABILITY WILL SUPPORT VIGOROUS UPDRAFTS CAPABL

sections.title: ERN TX INTO THE LOWER MS VALLEY TODAY INTO EVENING
sections.text: MCS WHICH EVOLVED OVER THE EDWARDS PLATEAU REGION SUNDAY EVENING HAS ESTABLISHED A WELL-DEFINED MCV AND COLD POOL OVER FAR SERN TX AS OF MID MORNING. 12Z LCH SOUNDING INDICATES THAT INFLOW AIR MASS TO THIS MCS IS VERY MOIST AND ALREADY MODERATELY TO STRONGLY UNSTABLE WITH LITTLE OR NO CONVECTIVE INHIBITION. LATEST MESOSCALE AND CONVECTION-ALLOWING MODEL GUIDANCE INDICATES THAT UPLIFT ALONG RESIDUAL MCS COLD POOL COUPLED WITH BROADER-SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH MCV AND COMPANION...SYNOPTIC VORTICITY MAXIMUM WILL FOSTER NUMEROUS TSTMS ACROSS THE REGION THIS AFTERNOON INTO EVENING. WHILE VERTICAL SHEAR WILL REMAIN RELATIVELY WEAK...THE POTENTIAL WILL EXIST FOR CORRIDORS OF WIND DAMAGE OWING TO WATER-LOADING EFFECTS WITH GROWING COLD POOLS.

sections.title: ERN TN INTO THE CAROLINAS THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING
sections.text: COLD FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH AMPLIFYING MIDLEVEL TROUGH MOVING INTO THE NWRN ATLANTIC WILL ADVANCE SWD TODAY. 12Z REGIONAL SOUNDINGS SHOW THAT MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES HAVE WEAKENED WHEN COMPARED TO THE PREVIOUS COUPLE OF DAYS. THIS WILL TEMPER THE DEGREE OF AIR MASS DESTABILIZATION BY AFTERNOON...THOUGH DAYTIME HEATING AND BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE 60S WILL STILL YIELD MLCAPE OF 1000-1500 J/KG. MODEL GUIDANCE SUGGESTS THAT THE STRONGEST MID AND UPPER-LEVEL FLOW WILL REMAIN ACROSS IMMEDIATE POST-FRONTAL AIR MASS...THOUGH SUFFICIENT VERTICAL SHEAR WILL EXIST ACROSS WARM SECTOR TO SUPPORT MULTICELL STORM CLUSTERS CAPABLE OF LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND PERHAPS SOME HAIL. ...ERN ND INTO THE UPPER GREAT LAKES THIS AFTERNOON THROUGH TONIGHT... CLUSTERS OF ELEVATED TSTMS ARE ONGOING ACROSS PARTS OF S-CNTRL ND AND NRN MN AT THE TERMINUS OF A WEAKENING NOCTURNAL LLJ WHERE LOW-LEVEL WAA AND ISENTROPIC ASCENT ARE BEING ENHANCED. 12Z ABR/MPX SOUNDINGS SAMPLED THE PRESENCE OF STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AND AN ELEVATED MOIST LAYER /AROUND 850 MB/ WHICH WERE CONTRIBUTING TO MUCAPE VALUES OF 1500-2500 J/KG. DESPITE A CONTINUED WEAKENING OF THE LLJ...MODEST WAA/ISENTROPIC ASCENT WILL PERSIST...

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER A PORTION OF SERN TX
sections.text: ...SWRN KS THROUGH WRN OK AND NWRN TX... STORMS ARE ON TRACK TO DEVELOP FROM SWRN KS THROUGH WRN OK AND NWRN TX THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING WITH A THREAT OF ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL. REF SWOMCD 415.

sections.text: HAVE EXPANDED THE SLIGHT RISK FARTHER NWD INTO SERN OK AND ARK TO ACCOUNT FOR THE NWD PROPAGATING MCS WITH A THREAT OF ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND.

sections.title: SRN PLAINS THROUGH KS/SERN NEB
sections.text: CLOSED LOW CONTINUES TO PROGRESS SLOWLY EWD THROUGH NM...WHILE A NEGATIVELY-TILTED SHORTWAVE TROUGH IS EXPECTED TO PROGRESS NWD FROM W/NW TX EARLY THIS EVENING TO WRN KS BY 06Z AND THEN TRACK NNWWD INTO NERN CO/SRN NEB BY 12Z TUESDAY. DPVA ALONG THE TRACK OF THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND DIFFLUENT MID-UPPER LEVEL FLOW FROM THE SRN PLAINS TO KS WILL SUPPORT ADDITIONAL TSTM DEVELOPMENT INTO THE EARLY OVERNIGHT PERIOD WITHIN A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS. THIS ACTIVITY WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP ALONG THE DRY LINE IN FAR WRN OK NWD TO THE KS PORTION OF A COLD FRONT WHICH EXTENDED FROM NERN NM THROUGH SWRN KS TO SERN NEB TO A SURFACE LOW IN NWRN IA. AN INCREASE IN LOW LEVEL CONVERGENCE AND SUBSEQUENT INCREASE IN TSTM COVERAGE IS POSSIBLE AS A N-S ORIENTED PACIFIC FRONT OVERTAKES THE NWRN TX/WRN OK DRY LINE THIS EVENING...WITH ACTIVITY ADVANCING INTO N TX/CENTRAL OK AND SRN/SERN KS TOWARD MIDNIGHT. THE EWD EXTENT OF THE SEVERE WEATHER THREAT MAY BE MITIGATED BY A W/NWWD MOVING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ATTENDANT TO THE EARLIER E TX/LOWER MS VALLEY MCS.

sections.title: CENTRAL TX
sections.text: THE AIR MASS ACROSS CENTRAL TX /FROM DRT AND TX HILL COUNTRY/ NWD INTO N TX IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN MODERATELY-STRONGLY UNSTABLE OVERNIGHT AND STRONGLY SHEARED. MODELS CONTINUE TO SUGGEST TSTMS WILL DEVELOP ALONG THE DRY LINE AS THE PACIFIC FRONT OVERTAKES THIS BOUNDARY. THIS LOW LEVEL CONVERGENCE COMBINED WITH DPVA ATTENDANT TO A SECONDARY MIDLEVEL IMPULSE ROUNDING THE BASE OF THE NM LOW REACHES CENTRAL TX TONIGHT. DEGREE OF INSTABILITY AND SHEAR VECTORS PERPENDICULAR TO THE BOUNDARY WILL SUPPORT SUPERCELLS WITH ALL FACETS OF SEVERE WEATHER POSSIBLE INCLUDING VERY LARGE HAIL.

sections.title: IA INTO SRN/CENTRAL MN/NRN AND CENTRAL WI TO LAKE MI
sections.text: THE NRN EXTENT OF THE SLIGHT RISK AREA WILL BE REMOVED IN THIS OUTLOOK ISSUANCE AS SURFACE BASED DEVELOPMENT WILL BE DIFFICULT DUE TO STRONGER CAPPING WITH NWD EXTENT. A FEW MODELS /12Z ECMWF/18Z GFS AND THE 15Z KF CONTROL MEMBER OF THE SREF/ SUGGEST TSTM DEVELOPMENT IS POSSIBLE INVOF THE NWRN IA SURFACE LOW AS IT TRACKS EWD THIS EVENING INTO NERN IA BY 12Z TUESDAY. VERY STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES /8-8.5 C PER KM/ EXTENDING NEWD INTO MN/WI AND MODERATE INSTABILITY WOULD SUPPORT HAIL AND STRONGER WINDS WITH ANY SUSTAINED ACTIVITY...THOUGH EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR SHOULD INITIALLY REMAIN WEAK. OTHERWISE...GREATER CONFIDENCE FOR TSTM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED LATER THIS EVENING INTO THE OVERNIGHT/EARLY TUESDAY AS ELEVATED STORMS DEVELOP OVER CENTRAL MN WITHIN A WAA REGIME IN THE NOSE OF A VEERING LLJ. ACTIVITY WILL SPREAD ESEWD INTO THE WRN GREAT LAKES REGION OVERNIGHT. AGAIN...WEAK SHEAR WILL PRECLUDE AN ORGANIZED SEVERE THREAT...BUT STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AND MODERATE ELEVATED INSTABILITY WILL SUPPORT AN ISOLATED/MARGINAL SEVERE RISK.

sections.title: E TX/SERN OK TO LOWER MS VALLEY/MID SOUTH
sections.text: REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED A RATHER LONG COMPOSITE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ATTENDANT TO THE WEAKENING...FORWARD PROPAGATING LOWER MS VALLEY TO ARKLATEX MCS CONTINUING TO MOVE NWWD THROUGH CENTRAL AND NERN OK AND NWD THROUGH NRN AR AND NRN MS. STABILIZED AIR MASS ACROSS THIS REGION FROM EARLIER ACTIVITY RESULTS IN A LIMITED SEVERE WEATHER THREAT. THUS...SEVERE PROBABILITIES HAVE BEEN REMOVED WITH THIS OUTLOOK ISSUANCE. ..SELECT A FORECASTER.. 04/03/2012
